findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_started, get_more_tools, assess_team_lead_readiness, build_mentoring_business_case · Private data: estimate_coaching_cost · Public sink: get_more_tools, build_mentoring_business_case.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_started, get_more_tools, assess_team_lead_readiness, build_mentoring_business_case · Private data: estimate_coaching_cost · Public sink: get_more_tools, build_mentoring_business_case

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "assess_team_lead_readiness" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
